mentions.name: Jigsaw Pic
mentions.description: Jigsaw Pic is a digital jigsaw puzzle game playable on an iPad, designed so kids can do puzzles on the go where physical puzzles aren't practical, with more puzzle categories planned.
mentions.problem: Bringing physical jigsaw puzzles along on family trips isn't feasible, so a tablet-based alternative is needed.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I have been working on Jigsaw Pic: https://jigsawpic.com

My 7 year old niece loves jigsaw puzzles, but a lot of the time I see her during family trips where taking puzzles along wouldn't be feasible. We usually have an iPad though. I plan to add more puzzle categories soon.
